title: bolanthus hirsutus var. barradensis
intro: Bolanthus hirsutus var. barradensis, commonly known as the desert marigold, is a plant species native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. The desert marigold has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, aiding in wound healing and soothing skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Bolanthus hirsutus var. barradensis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, which have antioxidant and antimicrobial effects. Further research is needed to confirm the full extent of the health benefits and therapeutic actions of this plant.
